description: Retrieves Checklist Schedule in a specified Project.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Checklist Schedule.

first_inspection_due_at.description: Due at timestamp of first inspection

ends_at.description: Due at timestamp of last inspection

next_due_at.description: Due at timestamp of next inspection to be created

frequency.description: Frequency at which Inspections are created by the Schedule.

total_inspections_scheduled.description: Total number of inspections that will be created by the Schedule.

inspection_template.description: Inspection Template the Schedule was created from.

items.description: User IDs assigned to the schedule

responsible_contractor_id.description: ID of Vendor responsible for the work being inspected

days_created_before_due_date.description: Number of days before an Inspection's due date that it is created.

private.description: Whether the Checklist Schedule is private.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values configured on the Checklist Schedule.
